rules.title: How the banzuke works
rules.points: Every day, everyone with a ranked daily scores points by their place in the group: the first as many as the group has members, every place after one less. Equal times share a place, a day not played scores nothing.
rules.titles: The week goes by points, then by days won. First is yokozuna, then ōzeki, sekiwake and komusubi, everyone after them a numbered maegashira. Whoever sat the week out is kyūjō.
rules.pace: The awards compare paces: a time against the median of all players that day, so Monday's easy daily and Sunday's oni count alike.
rules.members: Worked out from the group's current members, the week ends on Sunday at midnight UTC.

rules.fastest: The lowest total time of those who played the most days.
rules.cleanest: The most dailies without hints or checks.
rules.steadiest: The paces closest together, of at least three dailies.
rules.early_bird: Usually done the soonest after the daily comes out, of at least three dailies.
rules.improved: The pace that improved the most on the four weeks before.
rules.lantern: The slowest total of those who played all seven days. Somebody has to carry the lantern!
